settings.text:
At Mr Chocolate’s Travel, we’re thrilled to introduce you to runDisney at Walt Disney World Resort in Florida – a running experience unlike any other.

These events combine the excitement of a race with the magic of Disney, taking you on a course that winds through the iconic theme parks. From 5Ks and 10Ks to half marathons, full marathons, and even multi-race challenges, there’s something for every level of runner.

Along the way, participants can enjoy live entertainment, Disney Character appearances, and earn uniquely themed medals that are treasured long after race day. Whether you’re a first-time runner or a seasoned marathoner, runDisney offers an unforgettable adventure where every mile is magic.

settings.heading: Four Race Weekends Each Year
settings.text: Walt Disney World hosts four signature runDisney weekends annually, each with its own unique theme and race offerings.

settings.heading: runDisney Health & Fitness Expo
settings.text: Each race weekend begins with a multi-day expo, where runners collect their bibs, shop exclusive runDisney merchandise, and attend panels and demonstrations.

settings.heading: Costumes & Creativity
settings.text: Many runners dress up for race day, from subtle themed outfits to elaborate Disney character costumes, adding an extra layer of fun to the experience.

settings.heading: Race Day Atmosphere
settings.text: The pre-dawn starts are filled with music, energy, and excitement, creating a community feel before the first runner even crosses the start line.

settings.heading: Photo Opportunities
settings.text: Professional photographers capture moments along the course and at the finish line, giving runners lasting memories of their achievement.
